profile.headline: Software Engineer II | Real-Time Systems · Distributed Backend Design · Applied AI
profile.summary:
I build the backend systems behind Komatsu's autonomous mining fleet: real-time data services that ingest live telemetry, enforce safety-critical data contracts, and keep operations running at production scale.
Recently, I built an AI-augmented developer toolkit featuring a custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets coding agents like GitHub Copilot and Claude search, invoke, and validate service APIs with full codebase context, cutting API verification time by 50% and accelerating feature delivery by 2x.
What I bring to a team: I've reduced partner integration time by 50%, slashed onboarding from 4 weeks to 1, and achieved a 10x improvement in deployment velocity through Docker-based release automation. Before Komatsu, I shipped features to 200M+ users at Evernote and built deep learning pipelines at ISRO's Space Applications Center.
Always open to conversations about backend systems, AI-Native software engineering and tooling, or hard infrastructure problems. Feel free to reach out.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Architected a Kotlin/Spring Boot data aggregation service as the single source of truth for a mission-critical autonomous haulage system, processing real-time telemetry from an active mining fleet with operations valued at $100K+/hour and reducing partner integration time by 50%

• Built an AI-augmented developer toolkit — including a custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) server — enabling coding agents (GitHub Copilot, Claude) to search, invoke, and validate service APIs with full codebase context, cutting API verification time by 50% and accelerating feature delivery by 2x

• Designed a Docker-based release pipeline with Bash automation, eliminating manual configuration drift and achieving 10x improvement in deployment velocity for non-technical end users

• Hardened the Kotlin modulith's API surface by deploying an OAuth2/Keycloak authentication gateway with RBAC enforcement, cutting security configuration overhead by 35%

• Optimized geospatial rendering speed by 20% by integrating GeoServer with PostGIS and fine-tuning Hibernate/JPA queries to serve complex map layers for frontend visualization

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Slashed developer onboarding time by 75% (4 weeks to 1 week) by reverse-engineering legacy service APIs, producing end-to-end documentation, and establishing an Azure CI/CD pipeline that unblocked cross-team feature delivery

• Eliminated a scalability bottleneck in the C#/.NET Fleet Management System adapter, boosting data throughput by 40% and eradicating peak-load downtime — verified via load testing

• Integrated a real-time payload data pipeline for autonomous haul trucks, ingesting, validating, and processing live sensor data from onboard systems — increasing operator productivity by 20%

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Shipped the "Repeat After Completion" recurring-task feature to 50K+ beta users by implementing complex temporal state machine logic in TypeScript/GraphQL to handle dynamic recurrence intervals across global time zones

• Developed and deployed a reusable task-filtering component to 200M+ users across Web, Mobile, and Desktop clients, maintaining pixel-accurate UX fidelity to Figma specifications at global scale

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
• Achieved 92% detection accuracy on oceanic eddy identification by engineering a Python deep learning pipeline (Mask R-CNN, YOLO) with batch processing to handle terabytes of satellite imagery without memory overflow

• Transformed raw NetCDF oceanographic datasets into structured ML training inputs via Matplotlib visualizations, enabling binary classification of cyclic vs. acyclic ocean circulation patterns
positions.insights: Image Segmentation, Computer Vision and +4 skills
